title: Maximum Sum Subarray of Size K
problem: Given an array of integers and a number k, find the maximum sum of any contiguous subarray of size k.

steps.message: Start with an empty window. sum = 0, best = -∞.
Move right to 0 and add nums[0] = 2 to the sum.
Only 1 element(s) so far; keep expanding until the window has 3.
Move right to 1 and add nums[1] = 1 to the sum.
Only 2 element(s) so far; keep expanding until the window has 3.
Move right to 2 and add nums[2] = 5 to the sum.
Window [0, 2] has 3 elements. sum = 8 is a new best.
Drop nums[0] = 2 from the left so the window keeps size 3.
Move right to 3 and add nums[3] = 1 to the sum.
Window [1, 3] has 3 elements. sum = 7 does not beat best = 8.
Drop nums[1] = 1 from the left so the window keeps size 3.
Move right to 4 and add nums[4] = 3 to the sum.
Window [2, 4] has 3 elements. sum = 9 is a new best.
Drop nums[2] = 5 from the left so the window keeps size 3.
Move right to 5 and add nums[5] = 2 to the sum.
Window [3, 5] has 3 elements. sum = 6 does not beat best = 9.
Drop nums[3] = 1 from the left so the window keeps size 3.
Every window of size 3 was seen. Answer: 9.
